title: Ghost Gobbler
description: Navigate the maze, eat all the dots, and avoid the ghosts in this timeless arcade classic.
howToPlay: Use the Arrow keys to navigate the maze. Eat all dots and avoid the ghosts. Grab power pellets to eat ghosts for bonus points.

title: Brick Stacker
description: Stack falling blocks to clear lines and rack up points in the legendary puzzle game.
howToPlay: Move bricks with Left/Right Arrows, rotate with Up Arrow, and drop faster with Down Arrow. Form complete horizontal rows to clear them.

description: Join the numbers and get to the 2048 tile in this highly addictive sliding puzzle.
howToPlay: Use the Arrow keys to slide tiles. When two tiles of the same number collide, they merge into their sum. Try to reach the 2048 tile!

title: Hextris
description: Rotate the hexagon to prevent the blocks from stacking outside the outer grey hexagon.
howToPlay: Press Left/Right Arrows to rotate the hexagon. Match three blocks of the same color in a row to clear them before they overflow the gray border.

title: Retro Racer
description: A classic pseudo-3D arcade racing game inspired by OutRun. Shift gears and dodge traffic!
howToPlay: Use Left/Right Arrows to steer, Up Arrow to accelerate, and Down Arrow to brake. Avoid hitting roadside obstacles and other cars.

title: Floppy Wings
description: A simple yet challenging game where you control a bird and navigate through pipes!
howToPlay: Click the screen or press Spacebar to flap your wings. Fly through the gaps in the green pipes without crashing.

title: Wash the Cat
description: A simple yet challenging game where you try to wash the cat!
howToPlay: Move your brush with the mouse or touch screen. Scrub the dirty cat clean before the timer runs out.

title: Underrun
description: An intense, beautifully lit sci-fi twin-stick shooter. Delve into the dark facility, fight the swarm, and restore the systems.
howToPlay: Use WASD or Arrow keys to move your hacker clone, and Click to shoot incoming glitch enemies inside the computer systems.

title: Radius Raid
description: A highly kinetic, neon-drenched space shooter. Survive endless waves of enemies with tight controls and massive particle explosions.
howToPlay: Aim and shoot with the mouse. Move your ship with WASD or Arrow keys to dodge incoming enemy space waves and collect power-ups.

title: Space Huggers
description: A fast-paced run-and-gun platformer with tight controls, heavy weapons, and fully destructible environments.
howToPlay: Use WASD to run, jump, and climb. Aim and fire with the mouse. Free your fellow space marines and defeat the alien invaders.

title: Particle Clicker
description: Manage a high-tech particle accelerator. Generate data, secure funding, and unlock the secrets of physics in this incredibly polished incremental game.
howToPlay: Click the particle detector to generate research data and money. Buy upgrades and hire scientists to automate your particle accelerator.

title: Black Cat Squadron
description: A high-octane one-button shooter. Shoot, dodge, and survive the skies!
howToPlay: Steer your fighter jet with the mouse. Left-click to fire missiles at enemy squadrons and defend your base.

title: Catculus
description: A cat-themed math puzzle game. Use your feline wits to solve equations and reach the target number.
howToPlay: Solve basic math equations displayed on the screen. Select the correct answer quickly to feed the cat and earn high scores.

title: Ashes of Ulthar
description: An eerie pixel-art resource simulation. Recruit villagers, manage resources, and perform the ritual to save the village of Ulthar before sanity runs out.
howToPlay: Command your units by clicking on them and clicking on target locations. Defend the sacred grounds from the invading cat army.

title: Feast Night
description: A dark and atmospheric action game. Survive the night of the feast in this haunting experience.
howToPlay: Navigate the dark maze using the Arrow keys. Search for food while avoiding the monsters patrolling the corridors.

title: Six and Seven
description: A dungeon crawler where shadow demons fear the number 13. Figure out how to open the exit on each floor while fighting off the shadow demons.
howToPlay: Deploy numbers on the grid. Group matching numbers together to trigger chains and clear space in this tactical puzzle game.

title: Clawstrike
description: A fast-paced 2D action platformer. Avenge your human and cut through waves of enemies in this challenging die-and-retry game.
howToPlay: Use WASD or Arrow keys to run and jump. Press Spacebar to strike enemies with your claws and protect the forest.

title: Battle Commander
description: Lead your army to victory in this tactical medieval battle simulator. Strategic planning and resource management are key to conquest.
howToPlay: Click on your military barracks to deploy squads. Direct them to capture enemy territory and command strategic outposts.

title: Triskaideka
description: AARGH! Triskaideka Attacks! A retro-style space shooter challenge. Defend the galaxy in this fast-paced arcade experience.
howToPlay: Rotate the three-dimensional blocks to form complete shapes. Press Space to lock them in and clear rows before they hit the ceiling.

title: Thirteen Terrible Stunts
description: A collection of 13 fast-paced microgames featuring daring stunts. Can you survive them all in this 2024 JS13K entry?
howToPlay: Accelerate with Up Arrow and tilt your vehicle using Left/Right Arrows. Perform mid-air stunts and land safely to score points.

title: Witchcat
description: Guide the witch's cat through magical levels in this 2025 JS13K entry. Use feline agility and magic to overcome obstacles.
howToPlay: Guide the witch's cat using WASD or Arrow keys. Use magic spells with Spacebar to solve environmental puzzles and avoid curses.

title: Extreme Mini Massacre
description: An intense, retro-styled 2D action game where you battle through waves of enemies. Originally developed for the JS13KGAMES 2014 competition.
howToPlay: Move with Arrow keys and press Spacebar to swing your weapon. Clear out waves of small monsters in a fast-paced arena battle.

title: It's Raining Boxes?!
description: An arcade game where you must navigate through a falling storm of boxes. Survive the raining boxes!
howToPlay: Move Left and Right with the Arrow keys. Catch falling boxes of your color while avoiding mismatched boxes and dangerous bombs.

title: Elematter
description: A deep and strategic elemental tower defense game. Build towers, manage resources, and defend against waves of enemies.
howToPlay: Click on elements to change their state (Fire, Water, Earth). Match adjacent elements to trigger energy reaction chains.

title: Lost
description: A sci-fi action game where you navigate through space and face unknown threats. Originally a JS13K entry.
howToPlay: Use Arrow keys to explore the map. Interact with objects using Spacebar to find keys, unlock doors, and escape the labyrinth.

title: Neon Runner '84
description: A stylish retro-futuristic WebGL runner with 80s aesthetics and an original synthwave soundtrack.
howToPlay: Press Spacebar or Click to jump over obstacles and avoid neon chasms in this fast-paced infinite runner.

title: Super Pinto Rally Racer
description: A high-speed rally racing game. Shift gears, drift through corners, and beat the clock!
howToPlay: Steer your rally car with Left/Right Arrows. Hold Up Arrow to drift around corners and finish the race before the timer hits zero.

title: Air Fury
description: A high-octane aerial combat game inspired by Luftrausers. Dogfight in the skies, dodge bullets, and destroy enemy fleets.
howToPlay: Fly your plane using the Arrow keys or WASD. Press Spacebar to fire your machine guns at enemy fighters and target battleships.

title: Evil Glitch
description: A stylish, high-intensity neon-styled shooter with unique glitch effects. Survive the dimension collapse!
howToPlay: Move your ship with WASD and shoot with the mouse. Repair broken dimensional gates before the corruption takes over the system.

title: Glitch Buster
description: A glitch-themed platformer action game. Fix the world and bust those glitches in this high-speed challenge.
howToPlay: Use Arrow keys to navigate the platform network. Fire anti-glitch lasers with Spacebar to clean infected memory blocks.

title: AMAZ3D
description: A mind-bending 3D maze puzzle. Connect metaballs by rotating the maze cube and navigating complex pipes.
howToPlay: Navigate the 3D maze with WASD. Find the exit portal before the walls shift and trap you in the virtual labyrinth.

title: Mauja
description: A beautiful, snowy endless runner. Jump over obstacles and slide through the mountains in this atmospheric game.
howToPlay: Guide your avalanche using Left and Right Arrow keys. Grow larger by absorbing snow and debris while avoiding trees and warm cabins.

title: First Contact
description: A defense game where you must protect your planet from an alien invasion.
howToPlay: Click on the terminal options to communicate with the alien entity. Make diplomatic choices to avoid initiating interstellar war.

title: Back to the Island
description: A survival arcade game set on a mysterious island. Originally for JS13K 2020.
howToPlay: Explore the pixelated island using WASD. Collect materials, build shelters, and survive hostile native creatures.

title: Biscuit
description: A fast-paced arcade game where you control a hungry biscuit-loving character.
howToPlay: Help the puppy jump between floating cookies. Tap or Click at the right moment to perform a double jump and collect treats.

title: Highway 404
description: An endless driving game where you must navigate through a glitchy highway.
howToPlay: Steer your cyber-bike with Left and Right Arrows. Shift lanes to dodge firewalls and virus barriers on the digital highway.

title: Space Bouncer
description: A futuristic action game featuring cybernetic enhancements. Technically impressive JS13K entry.
howToPlay: Tap or Click to bounce your astronaut between gravity rings. Avoid incoming space debris and maintain your orbit.

title: Tindeath
description: Explore a dense, pixelated forest in this 2022 JS13K entry. Atmospheric and mysterious.
howToPlay: Swipe Left or Right on target profiles. Accept missions or reject targets to manage your mercenary syndicate's reputation.

title: The Last Spartan
description: Battle through waves of enemies as the last remaining Spartan warrior. Intense 2D combat.
howToPlay: Fight off incoming hordes of invaders. Move with Arrow keys and strike with Spacebar to hold your ground at the pass.

title: Deep Space Voyager
description: A sci-fi adventure where you are lost in the deep reaches of space. Top-down space combat.
howToPlay: Pilot your spaceship using Arrow keys. Left-click to fire plasma bolts at meteors and enemy alien cruisers.

title: Norman the Necromancer
description: Play as Norman, a necromancer raising an army of the undead to conquer his enemies.
howToPlay: Cast necromancer spells using the mouse. Raise skeleton warriors and direct them to attack incoming paladin legions.

title: Retro 3D Arena
description: A technical marvel: a fully functional 3D retro shooter in less than 13KB. Quake-inspired.
howToPlay: Move with WASD, jump with Spacebar, and aim/shoot with your mouse. Clear all enemy monsters in the level to open the escape portal.

title: Roll Tanks
description: A physics-based tank battle game where movement is half the challenge. Strategic and fun.
howToPlay: Move your rolling tank with WASD. Rotate the turret with the mouse and click to fire explosive rounds at enemy target blocks.

title: Sojuz 404
description: A space-themed action game with unique vector graphics and high-speed gameplay.
howToPlay: Pilot the Soyuz spacecraft through asteroid belts. Use Up/Down Arrows to adjust throttle and Left/Right to align docking ports.

title: Ninja
description: A stealth-action game where you must navigate through shadows and avoid guards.
howToPlay: Run and wall-jump using WASD. Click the mouse to throw shurikens at guards and perform silent stealth takedowns.

title: Swagshot
description: A stylish retro-styled shooter with intense gameplay and glitch effects.
howToPlay: Pull back, aim, and release the mouse to launch the ball. Bounce off walls to land trick shots into the goals.

title: Tenacity
description: A high-speed arcade game that tests your reflexes and persistence.
howToPlay: Tap or click the screen to flap and dodge obstacles. Time your jumps perfectly to keep running through the moving gears.

title: Two Ships Passing in the Night
description: A unique puzzle/action game about two ships navigating through the dark.
howToPlay: Control both ships simultaneously. Use WASD for the left ship and Arrow keys for the right ship. Dodge incoming hazards.

title: Callisto
description: A 3D space-themed adventure set on the moon of Jupiter.
howToPlay: Navigate the frozen moon using WASD. Manage your oxygen levels and repair the satellite base station before freezing.

title: Minipunk
description: A cyberpunk-themed arcade game with retro aesthetics.
howToPlay: Explore the neon cyberpunk streets. Hack terminal nodes by matching security keys within the time limit.

title: Stolen Sword
description: An action-adventure game where you must recover your stolen legendary sword.
howToPlay: Use WASD to move and Spacebar to swing the sword. Defeat dungeon guards to retrieve your stolen weapon.

title: Cat Goric
description: Escape from the warp chamber in this mind-bending puzzle platformer. Every move matters!
howToPlay: Drag and drop the incoming blocks into categories. Match categories correctly to clear rows and keep the grid clean.

title: Death Game
description: A high-stakes action game where every decision could be your last. Survive the arena!
howToPlay: Survive the gauntlet. Use WASD to dodge laser grids and time your dashes to avoid falling spikes.

title: Duszki
description: A ghost-themed arcade game. Guide your spirit through mysterious realms.
howToPlay: Guide the friendly spirits using the mouse. Help them return to their portals while avoiding negative shadow entities.
